data.gender_notes: Lioraelle is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Liora comes from the word 'leor' which means 'my light'. In Greek, Raelle is derived from the word 'helios' which means 'sun'. The name Lioraelle therefore means 'God is my light and my sun' or 'my light comes from God and the sun' in Christian tradition. The name Lioraelle carries the meaning “Light, God is my light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Lioraelle usually hope their child will grow to embody light, god is my light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name reflects the belief in God as the ultimate source of light and life, and the promise that He will always be with us, shining bright in our lives.
data.etymology: Lioraelle belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, God is my light.”

in_hebrew.name: ליווראל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ליווראל הוא שם שמקורו במילים 'אור' ו'אלוהים', ומשמעותו היא 'אלוהים הוא האור שלי' או 'אור האלוהים'. השם נגזר מהשפה העברית ומשקף את הקשר בין האור לאלוהים, כפי שנראה בכתבי הקודש.

in_greek.name: Λιοραέλλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Λιοραέλλ είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από τις λέξεις 'φως' και 'Θεός', και σημαίνει 'Θεός είναι το φως μου' ή 'Φως του Θεού'. Το όνομα αυτό αντανακλά τη σχέση μεταξύ του φωτός και του Θεού, όπως αυτή παρουσιάζεται στα ιερά κείμενα.

in_latin.name: Lioraelle
in_latin.long_meaning: Lioraelle est nomen quod ex vocibus 'lux' et 'Deus' derivatur, significans 'Deus est lux mea' vel 'Lux Dei'. Nomen hoc reflectit nexum inter lucem et Deum, sicut in sacris scripturis apparet.

The name Lioraelle gained popularity in the 16th century when it was used as the name of a mystic and visionary woman in the French novel 'Manon Lescaut'. Lioraelle was portrayed as a passionate and spiritual woman who lived a life of unconventional love and devotion.

This name is gaining popularity in modern Christian circles due to its unique and contemporary sound, while still holding deep biblical meaning. It's often seen on platforms like Pinterest and Instagram, where parents-to-be are seeking inspiration for their baby's name. Baby name websites are also a popular source for discovering this name, as they provide a wide range of options for those looking for a name with both historical and modern appeal.
